+## Summary
+
+Increase the pricing cache TTL from 900 seconds (15 minutes) to 3600 seconds (1 hour) to reduce redundant lookups and improve performance.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Raised `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 in `pricing_cache.py`
+- Removed the deprecated `lookup()` function that was only used for fallback snapshot handling
+
+## Why
+
+Extending the cache TTL to 1 hour balances freshness with performance. This reduces the frequency of cache misses and downstream feed lookups while maintaining reasonable data freshness for pricing information that doesn't change as frequently as the previous 15-minute window.
+
+## Testing
+
+- Verify pricing cache works correctly with the extended TTL
+- Confirm no regressions in pricing lookup latency
+- Validate that stale pricing data is acceptable within the 1-hour window
